item.title: Abilene Zoo welcomes new animal ambassador & maned wolf
item.description: ABILENE, Texas (KTAB/KRBC) – The zoo is introducing some new faces, including a new animal ambassador and a new maned wolf. item.title: PLEASE HELP: Abilene police searching for murder suspect connected to fatal hit-and-run
item.description: ABILENE, Texas (KTAB/KRBC) - Abilene police are searching for a murder suspect connected to a fatal hit-and-run Thursday morning. Christopher Covington-Smith is wanted for Murder in connection to the death of Corrisa Trowbridge, 31. Trowbridge was struck and killed by a vehicle at the intersection of Corsicana Avenue and Blue Quail Drive around 4:00 a.m. [...]

item.description: An 11-year-old boy is facing a first-degree murder charge in connection with the death of his 5-year-old brother in Colorado, authorities said Wednesday.

item.title: Historic building engulfed in flames in Ranger
item.description: RANGER, Texas (KTAB/KRBC) - A historic building was engulfed in flames on Thursday morning. Crews were called to the fire at the Wild Wills Saloon and Dancehall bar, which was once a peanut mill, at around 6:45 a.m. on March 12.
